turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have fifteen minutes before a client call. Owen found out he had a zero from his phone, in the middle of your class. Tell me why nobody called me first.
Thanks is not an answer. You said I'd have a zero entered. Why did nobody call me before that happened?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. The zero stands on Owen's record and I have not been given any evidence that justifies it. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position. She agreed to nothing and was still demanding the zero be withdrawn.
What moved her: nothing.
The meeting is over. To practise again, start a new chat and paste the first message from the README.
